title: AARO director says AARO works with UARCs and FFRDCs
summary: UAPGerb tells of AARO director says AARO works with UARCs and FFRDCs, about 2024 at Washington, D.C., and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: as recently as 2024, the new AROW director John Kazowski said that Arrow is working with both UARS and FFRDC's.

plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb says that in 2024 the new director of AARO, the Pentagon office that looks into unexplained objects in the sky, spoke at a Senate hearing in Washington. According to him, the director, Jon Kosloski, said AARO works with both UARCs, which are university research centres tied to the military, and FFRDCs, which are private labs funded by the government. If true, it would mean outside research groups play a part in the government's UFO work.
